title: Agent Instruction File Hygiene & Boundary Control

claims.assertion: Agent instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) must eliminate generic AI advice, avoid lint leakage, and stay under 150 lines.
Explicit negative boundaries ('what NOT to touch') and single-source build/test execution seams prevent rogue modifications.
Post-mortem instruction updates when agent mistakes occur harden the developer loop permanently.

context: Knowledge item ki_self_20260828_01: Agent Instruction File Hygiene & Boundary Control
distilled_learning:
### Distilled Heuristic
Repository agent configuration files (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`) must remain lean (<150 lines), free of generic tutorials or lint leakage, and define explicit execution seams (build/test/lint) along with strict negative boundaries ('what NOT to touch').
